jokes:
1. The morning sun peeked in and said, "Rise and shine!"
My pillow replied, "Give us just five more minutes."

2. My tea asked why I was late.
I said I had a long meeting with my dreams.

3. A book said, "Open me and learn something new."
Sleep said, "I have a lesson for you too."

4. I packed an umbrella for the rain,
then left it at home and got a fresh new hairstyle.

5. A little patience goes a long way,
especially when the kettle is slow today.

6. My wallet felt brave until the bill arrived;
then even the coins went quiet.

jokes:
1. The lights went out during dinner.
Dad said, "Good thing we were eating sandwiches."

2. My plant looked droopy, so I moved it into the sun.
Now it is thriving and judging my gardening skills.

3. The doorbell rang while we were making chutney.
Our guest asked for a taste, so we handed over the recipe.

4. The teacher asked why I was late.
I said the clock was early, and I did not want to interrupt it.

5. My friend asked what I should call my new alarm clock.
I said, "The boss. It is the only one I listen to."

6. I checked the weather before leaving.
The forecast said sunshine, so I packed an umbrella just in case.
